profile.headline: AWS Partner Solutions Architect | Solutions Engineer | Helping partners and customers adopt Cloud & Generative AI solutions | AWS Marketplace | Technical Enablement
profile.summary:
I help partners and customers turn complex cloud and AI technologies into practical business solutions.

My background spans customer-facing technical leadership across GenAI workflows, cloud architecture, integrations, AWS Marketplace, and partner enablement. I’ve worked with organizations ranging from startups to enterprise customers to guide technical discovery, solution design, AI adoption, modernization initiatives, and go-to-market readiness.

Recent work included supporting AI and automation initiatives leveraging Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Q, designing cloud-based workshop environments using services such as Lambda, Athena, S3, and CloudFormation, and helping partners navigate integrations, compliance requirements, and operational scalability.

I enjoy translating ambiguity into actionable technical strategies, connecting business goals with practical implementation paths, and helping teams move from ideas to production-ready solutions. I also stay hands-on through full-stack development, building and maintaining production applications and integrations using technologies including React, TypeScript, Node.js, APIs, and modern content platforms.

positions.title: Web developer (Volunteer)
positions.description:
Designed, built, and deployed a full-stack web application using React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, including a custom REST API supporting client inquiries and service discovery.
 
Architected and integrated a Sanity-based content management system using TypeScript, GROQ, Portable Text, structured content models, and relational references to enable business-managed publishing, category filtering, and configurable featured content.
 
Partnered with the business owner to translate evolving business and editorial requirements into maintainable technical solutions and user experiences.
 
Own ongoing production development and operations, including requirements translation, dependency and runtime upgrades, debugging, environment and CORS configuration, and Heroku deployment.

positions.title: Partner Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Partner Solutions Architect supporting ISVs and enterprise partners across cloud modernization, AI adoption, integrations, and AWS Marketplace initiatives.

• Guided partners through solution design, technical validation, and operationalization across cloud, AI, migration, and compute workloads, supporting customer adoption and influencing millions in pipeline revenue.

• Collaborated with partners on GenAI and automation initiatives leveraging Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Q, including AI-assisted entity resolution workflows and agent-driven compliance automation use cases.

• Designed and delivered technical workshops, enablement programs, and calibration guidance that reduced validation review time from ~2 hours to ~40 minutes and contributed to a 150% increase in partner validation demand.

• Designed cloud-based workshop and demo environments using services including Lambda, Athena, S3, CloudFormation, monitoring, and encryption to support hands-on partner learning and solution adoption.

• Worked with partners to architect integrations involving AWS services, SaaS platforms, AI/ML workflows, and AWS Marketplace onboarding, helping customers navigate scalability, compliance, and operational requirements.

• Partnered across specialist teams, service teams, engineering, product, and go-to-market stakeholders to unblock technical challenges, shape implementation strategies, and accelerate customer outcomes.

positions.title: Physical Therapist Assistant
positions.description:
Rehabilitated patients following hospitalization by delivering individualized therapy sessions focused on improving function, reducing pain, and meeting care plan goals. Combined clinical expertise with clear communication and efficient documentation to support quality outcomes.

Highlights:
• Regularly exceeded 85% productivity target, achieving 90% through effective time management, concurrent supervision, and detailed EMR documentation.
• Designed and adapted personalized treatment sessions to meet evolving patient needs and improve long-term outcomes.
• Mentored and supervised two PTA students through hands-on internships, progressing them from observation to full caseload management.
• Provided caregiver instruction to support safe, effective at-home recovery and treatment adherence.
positions.insights: Analytical Skills, Oral Communication and +4 skills
